$comment: Device-first accounts: ADR 0057 and ADR 0059 (bipe/docs/adr), security.md rules 5 and 6. PIN rule, reference pinProblem() in tools/lib/registries.mjs, cases in test-vectors/pins.json. A PIN is exactly pinLength ASCII digits. It is weak when all digits are the same (repeated_digit), when each digit is the previous digit plus 1 or minus 1 modulo 10 (sequence: 12345678, 87654321, 90123456), or when it is a real calendar date as DDMMYYYY or YYYYMMDD with the year from pinDateYearMin to pinDateYearMax (date). Check order: not_digits, wrong_length, repeated_digit, sequence, date. pinMaxWrongTries: wrong PINs in total, over every recovery path, before the server blocks the PIN until a reset; a correct PIN sets the count to 0. recoveryDelayHours: wait between the factor plus PIN and access (or the new PIN). guardianApprovalsMax: approvals needed = min(guardians, guardianApprovalsMax). recoveryLinkMinutes: life of the recovery link in the email. emailVerifyLinkHours: life of the link that confirms a fallback email. recoveryClaimDays: after the delay ends, the new device has this long to collect the result. Linked recovery (ADR 0096): providers are recovery factors, need the existing PIN after provider proof, wait 24 hours, and cannot reset a PIN. One account of each provider per Bipe account.
